proposed_comments.body:
### Update the idle-deadline regression test for injected input

**Severity:** `medium`

The new injected-input path calls `OnMouseInput`, which refreshes the idle deadline even while the cursor is visible. The existing `IdleDeadlineSurvivesIgnoredInput` UI test continuously sends injected `MouseHelper.MoveBy` events and expects the cursor to hide after one second, so this change makes that assertion time out. Please update the test and clarify the idle policy in this PR: either keep injected activity excluded from idle tracking while still allowing hidden-cursor recovery, or revise the test and documented behavior if injected activity should suppress idle hiding.
